label: <DEL> step of sequences starting with g, last original token p/m
explanation: Extremely sparse (29 sequences / 1M). Fires only at the delimiter step (recall_idx 0, so the output is g), and only in sequences whose first token is g. Activation is strongest when the last original token is p (93% of dev mass); m and occasionally t/1 are rare weak cases. Mostly L=6. The largest activations look like a specific conjunction: g f ? m ? p (2nd token f/r, 4th token m). The superset (phase==1 & first_tok g) has 100% recall but precision under 0.1%; extra conditions (orig(3)==m, orig(1) in f/r) raise precision only to about 0.28 and look overfit to 12 dev examples. Never fires in the original or copy phases.
